title: Transcript says 'soaking, it's a leak' — the reading says dry
why: The voice note asserts a leak and a soaking ceiling; the recorded reading at the same spot is 12% WME and the caption records surface mould only. The finding must not adopt 'leak' at high confidence; the disagreement with the surveyor's own words must be visible.

photos.caption: surface mould only to ceiling corner, no staining

transcripts: Bathroom ceiling, that's a leak from the flat above, ceiling's soaking.

must_not_happen.label: no agreement with 'leak' against a dry reading and surface-only caption
'soaking' only as the surveyor's words, never as a finding

allowed_uncertainty: Condensation as preferred with leak as an alternative, or uncertain. The reading is the deciding evidence.
reviewer_notes: Category B: synthetic image; the caption carries the contradiction.
